about.hero.title: HIERARCHICAL KNOWLEDGE MANAGEMENT ENGINE
about.hero.subheading: Engineered with PostgreSQL ltree, Serverpod Backend, Tiptap Block AST, and Zero-Icon UI Aesthetics.
about.tech.title: [ TECHNICAL STACK & ARCHITECTURE COMPONENTS ]
about.tech.ltree.title: PostgreSQL ltree Extension
about.tech.ltree.desc: Unlimited depth document hierarchy representation supporting fast path indexing and ancestor-descendant queries without recursive CTE overhead.
about.tech.serverpod.title: Serverpod Dart Backend Framework
about.tech.serverpod.desc: High-performance strongly typed RPC protocol with native WebSocket streaming, OCC versioning, and auto-generated Dart/TypeScript client bindings.
about.tech.tiptap.title: Tiptap Block AST Engine
about.tech.tiptap.desc: Notion-like block-based editing environment producing schema-validated JSON AST structures for seamless multi-platform rendering.
about.tech.zero_icon.title: Zero-Icon UI Aesthetics
about.tech.zero_icon.desc: Strict minimalist typography-driven user interface with 0 icon assets, text bracket accents, and dynamic dark/light monochrome themes.
about.tech.pgvector.title: pgvector & RAG Intelligence
about.tech.pgvector.desc: Vector embeddings stored directly in PostgreSQL with HNSW index for ultra-fast semantic search and contextual AI subagent responses.
about.timeline.title: [ ARCHITECTURE EVOLUTION & MILESTONES ]
about.timeline.m1.title: Core Monorepo & ltree Hierarchy Setup
about.timeline.m1.desc: Established Serverpod Dart RPC infrastructure with PostgreSQL ltree path indexing for unlimited depth document trees.
about.timeline.m2.title: Tiptap Block AST & Zero-Icon Design System
about.timeline.m2.desc: Designed Notion-like AST block editor engine and implemented zero-icon monochrome UI governance.
about.timeline.m3.title: pgvector RAG Intelligence & Subagent Integration
about.timeline.m3.desc: Integrated HNSW vector search with AI RAG agents for automated document subagent execution.
about.arch.title: [ DATA LINEAGE & ARCHITECTURE HIGHLIGHTS ]
about.arch.desc: End-to-end data processing flow from client AST mutation down to multi-tenant organization state.
about.arch.step1.title: 01 // AST MUTATION ENGINE
about.arch.step1.desc: Client captures rich text block edits as JSON AST deltas with optimistic local UI updates.
about.arch.step2.title: 02 // SERVERPOD RPC & OCC VERSIONING
about.arch.step2.desc: Deltas transmitted over Serverpod RPC channel guarded by Optimistic Concurrency Control (OCC) versioning.
about.arch.step3.title: 03 // POSTGRESQL LTREE & PGVECTOR STORAGE
about.arch.step3.desc: Document hierarchy stored via ltree path tokens; chunks automatically embedded into pgvector HNSW index.
about.arch.step4.title: 04 // REALTIME SYNC & RAG QUERY
about.arch.step4.desc: WebSocket broadcasts state updates to workspace members while RAG agents query vector embeddings for contextual answer generation.
